title: Tiffin Label
statement:
A variable is a labeled box. Write a function that takes a label (string) and a value, and returns a single string in the form "label=value".
Example: label_box("age", 12) → "age=12".
hints: Convert the value to text if needed.
Join the label, an equals sign, and the value.

starterCode.python:
def label_box(label: str, value) -> str:
    pass

solution.approach: Return the label, then '=', then the value converted to a string.

code.python:
def label_box(label: str, value) -> str:
    return f"{label}={value}"

analogy: writing the sticker on a tiffin box
